ai_budgets_scope_ids_chk.name: ai_budgets_scope_ids_chk
ai_budgets_scope_ids_chk.value:
CASE scope
            WHEN 'instance' THEN owner_account_id IS NULL AND location_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL
            WHEN 'instance_account' THEN location_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL
            WHEN 'account' THEN owner_account_id IS NOT NULL AND location_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL
            WHEN 'location' THEN owner_account_id IS NOT NULL AND location_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL
            WHEN 'member' THEN owner_account_id IS NOT NULL AND location_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL
            ELSE owner_account_id IS NULL AND location_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL END

ai_budgets_minute_day_chk.name: ai_budgets_minute_day_chk
ai_budgets_minute_day_chk.value:
(tokens_per_minute IS NULL AND tokens_per_day IS NULL)
          OR (scope IN ('instance', 'account') AND task IS NOT NULL)

ai_model_prices_rates_chk.name: ai_model_prices_rates_chk
ai_model_prices_rates_chk.value:
input_per_mtok >= 0 AND output_per_mtok >= 0 AND reasoning_per_mtok >= 0
          AND cached_input_per_mtok >= 0 AND per_image >= 0

ai_model_prices_listing_chk.name: ai_model_prices_listing_chk
ai_model_prices_listing_chk.value: source = 'admin' OR listing_fetched_at IS NOT NULL

ai_model_prices_superseded_chk.name: ai_model_prices_superseded_chk
ai_model_prices_superseded_chk.value: superseded_at IS NULL OR superseded_at >= effective_from

ai_providers_base_url_chk.name: ai_providers_base_url_chk
ai_providers_base_url_chk.value: base_url IS NULL OR (base_url ~ '^https?://' AND char_length(base_url) <= 300)

ai_providers_scope_ids_chk.name: ai_providers_scope_ids_chk
ai_providers_scope_ids_chk.value:
CASE scope WHEN 'instance' THEN owner_account_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL
                     WHEN 'account' THEN owner_account_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL
                     ELSE user_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_account_id IS NULL END

ai_providers_compatible_chk.name: ai_providers_compatible_chk
ai_providers_compatible_chk.value: kind <> 'openai_compatible' OR base_url IS NOT NULL

ai_providers_keyed_chk.name: ai_providers_keyed_chk
ai_providers_keyed_chk.value: kind = 'openai_compatible' OR key_ciphertext IS NOT NULL OR disabled_at IS NOT NULL

generated.as:
CASE WHEN task LIKE 'extract\_%' THEN 'extraction'
               WHEN task LIKE 'assistant\_%' THEN 'assistant'
               WHEN task LIKE 'embed\_%' THEN 'embeddings' ELSE 'test' END

llm_calls_not_sent_chk.name: llm_calls_not_sent_chk
llm_calls_not_sent_chk.value: sent OR (input_tokens IS NULL AND output_tokens IS NULL AND cost_amount IS NULL)

llm_calls_price_chk.name: llm_calls_price_chk
llm_calls_price_chk.value: cost_source NOT IN ('price_table', 'price_table_later') OR price_id IS NOT NULL

llm_calls_payer_chk.name: llm_calls_payer_chk
llm_calls_payer_chk.value:
CASE paying_scope
            WHEN 'instance' THEN paying_account_id IS NULL AND paying_user_id IS NULL
            WHEN 'account' THEN paying_account_id IS NOT NULL AND paying_user_id IS NULL
            ELSE paying_user_id IS NOT NULL AND paying_account_id IS NULL END

inbox_items_subject_chk.name: inbox_items_subject_chk
inbox_items_subject_chk.value: kind = 'sync_drop' OR num_nonnulls(thing_id, purchase_id, meter_reading_id, code) >= 1

attachments_one_subject_chk.name: attachments_one_subject_chk
attachments_one_subject_chk.value:
num_nonnulls(thing_id, place_id, purchase_id, meter_reading_id, warranty_id, claim_id,
                       loan_id, incident_id, valuation_id, service_record_id,
                       expiring_document_id) <= 1

attachments_url_chk.name: attachments_url_chk
attachments_url_chk.value: url IS NULL OR (url ~ '^https?://' AND char_length(url) <= 2000)

files_size_chk.name: files_size_chk
files_size_chk.value: (width IS NULL OR width > 0) AND (height IS NULL OR height > 0)

import_runs_progress_chk.name: import_runs_progress_chk
import_runs_progress_chk.value: progress >= 0 AND (total IS NULL OR progress <= total)

loans_due_chk.name: loans_due_chk
loans_due_chk.value: due_on IS NULL OR due_on >= (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 1

loans_returned_chk.name: loans_returned_chk
loans_returned_chk.value: returned_at IS NULL OR returned_at >= started_at

meters_label_chk.name: meters_label_chk
meters_label_chk.value: label IS NULL OR char_length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

export_runs_progress_chk.name: export_runs_progress_chk
export_runs_progress_chk.value: progress_done >= 0 AND progress_total >= 0 AND progress_done <= progress_total

export_runs_storage_key_chk.name: export_runs_storage_key_chk
export_runs_storage_key_chk.value: storage_key IS NULL OR storage_key = 'x/' || id::text || '.zip'

places_unplaced_top_level_chk.name: places_unplaced_top_level_chk
places_unplaced_top_level_chk.value: NOT is_unplaced OR parent_id IS NULL

places_not_own_parent_chk.name: places_not_own_parent_chk
places_not_own_parent_chk.value: parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id

purchases_dated_chk.name: purchases_dated_chk
purchases_dated_chk.value: purchased_on IS NOT NULL OR review_state = 'draft'

purchases_money_chk.name: purchases_money_chk
purchases_money_chk.value: (total IS NULL AND tax IS NULL) OR currency IS NOT NULL

place_kinds_name_chk.name: place_kinds_name_chk
place_kinds_name_chk.value: name IS NULL OR char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

place_kinds_named_chk.name: place_kinds_named_chk
place_kinds_named_chk.value: owner_account_id IS NULL OR name IS NOT NULL OR key IN ('floor', 'room', 'zone', 'closet')

type_fields_label_chk.name: type_fields_label_chk
type_fields_label_chk.value: label IS NULL OR char_length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

type_fields_unit_chk.name: type_fields_unit_chk
type_fields_unit_chk.value: unit IS NULL OR char_length(unit) BETWEEN 1 AND 12

types_named_chk.name: types_named_chk
types_named_chk.value: name IS NOT NULL OR builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR copied_from_id IS NOT NULL

types_name_chk.name: types_name_chk
types_name_chk.value: name IS NULL OR char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

types_default_meter_chk.name: types_default_meter_chk
types_default_meter_chk.value: default_meter IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(default_meter) IN ('object', 'null')

types_field_group_chk.name: types_field_group_chk
types_field_group_chk.value: NOT is_field_group OR (parent_id IS NULL AND cardinality(field_groups) = 0)

types_not_own_parent_chk.name: types_not_own_parent_chk
types_not_own_parent_chk.value: parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id

report_runs_locations_chk.name: report_runs_locations_chk
report_runs_locations_chk.value:
cardinality(location_ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
          AND (location_id IS NULL OR location_ids = ARRAY[location_id])

report_runs_progress_chk.name: report_runs_progress_chk
report_runs_progress_chk.value: progress_done >= 0 AND progress_total >= 0 AND progress_done <= progress_total

expiring_documents_other_chk.name: expiring_documents_other_chk
expiring_documents_other_chk.value: kind <> 'other' OR title IS NOT NULL

schedules_meter_thing_chk.name: schedules_meter_thing_chk
schedules_meter_thing_chk.value: meter_id IS NULL OR thing_id IS NOT NULL

schedules_one_off_chk.name: schedules_one_off_chk
schedules_one_off_chk.value: due_on IS NULL OR (every_months IS NULL AND every_units IS NULL)

secret_values_thing_current_uq.name: secret_values_thing_current_uq
secret_values_thing_current_uq.where: superseded_at IS NULL AND thing_id IS NOT NULL

secret_values_place_current_uq.name: secret_values_place_current_uq
secret_values_place_current_uq.where: superseded_at IS NULL AND place_id IS NOT NULL

legacy_codes_code_chk.name: legacy_codes_code_chk
legacy_codes_code_chk.value: char_length(code) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND code = upper(btrim(code))

own_code_settings_rule_chk.name: own_code_settings_rule_chk
own_code_settings_rule_chk.value:
num_nonnulls(rule_pattern, rule_message, rule_example) IN (0, 3)
          AND char_length(rule_pattern) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
          AND char_length(rule_message) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
          AND char_length(rule_example) BETWEEN 1 AND 100

locations_purge_needs_delete_chk.name: locations_purge_needs_delete_chk
locations_purge_needs_delete_chk.value: purge_after IS NULL OR deleted_at IS NOT NULL

sync_tombstones_key_chk.name: sync_tombstones_key_chk
sync_tombstones_key_chk.value:
(entity_type IN ('code', 'legacy_code')) = (entity_key IS NOT NULL)
          AND (entity_key IS NULL
               OR (char_length(entity_key) <= 400 AND entity_id = md5(entity_key)::uuid))

short_ids_target_chk.name: short_ids_target_chk
short_ids_target_chk.value:
CASE state WHEN 'blank' THEN num_nonnulls(thing_id, place_id) = 0
                     WHEN 'assigned' THEN num_nonnulls(thing_id, place_id) = 1
                     ELSE num_nonnulls(thing_id, place_id) <= 1 END

things_not_own_container_chk.name: things_not_own_container_chk
things_not_own_container_chk.value: container_id IS NULL OR container_id <> id

things_named_chk.name: things_named_chk
things_named_chk.value: name IS NOT NULL OR review_state = 'draft'

things_name_chk.name: things_name_chk
things_name_chk.value: name IS NULL OR char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200

things_in_use_chk.name: things_in_use_chk
things_in_use_chk.value: lifecycle <> 'in_use' OR (ended_on IS NULL AND ended_price IS NULL AND ended_to IS NULL)

saved_views_shared_chk.name: saved_views_shared_chk
saved_views_shared_chk.value: NOT shared OR location_id IS NOT NULL

claims_money_chk.name: claims_money_chk
claims_money_chk.value: (cost IS NULL AND covered_amount IS NULL) OR currency IS NOT NULL

claims_closed_on_chk.name: claims_closed_on_chk
claims_closed_on_chk.value: closed_on IS NULL OR closed_on >= opened_on

CASE WHEN lifetime THEN NULL
               WHEN ends_on IS NOT NULL THEN ends_on
               ELSE (starts_on + make_interval(months => term_months))::date - 1 END
